text:
maya: Morning — quick poll: are we ok switching coffee beans to a local roaster? I can pick up a 5lb bag tomorrow morning. :coffee:
devon: I'm down as long as they have a decaf option. our decaf is single-serving disaster. :grimacing:
sam: +1 for local. also low on oat milk — fridge shows 1 carton. can we add that to the run? :grimacing: (jk but seriously)
len: I'm out tomorrow but can paypal for my share. how much is the 5lb?
maya: Good Q — roaster charges $45 for a 5lb bag, decaf +$10. Oat milk 2L is $6. Shall I get 1 decaf bag + 1 regular + 2 oat?
rachel: Can someone also grab a small box of tea bags? a few people prefer tea.
devon: I can swing by at 9:15am, happy to pick up if others chip in. :thumbsup:
maya: Awesome — vote: 'maya pick (9:15)' / 'devon pick (9:15)' / 'no thanks' — reply with choice.
sam: maya pick
len: maya pick — I'll send $10 to maya
rachel: devon pick (I have a meeting at 9 but appreciate the oat milk)
ops-bot: Reminder — kitchen fridge cleanout scheduled Friday. Please label perishables.
maya: Noted. total tally: 1 decaf bag, 1 reg bag, 2 oat milks, 1 box tea. We'll split cost 6 ways. I'll PM PayPal. Thanks! :coffee::heart:
